opinion.headline: Go and see
opinion.hook: Gossip spreads quickly and can cause harm.
opinion.summary: It is better to pause idle talk and verify information. Toyota's Genchi Genbutsu principle encourages seeing things for yourself. Apply this to negative talk about others.
